about.title: How This Works & Clinical Boundaries
about.subtitle: We are completely transparent and honest about technology limitations and patient safety.
about.primaryNoticeQuote: “DawaiSaathi is an assistive support tool, not a doctor. (This is a support tool, not a doctor.)”
about.primaryNoticeBody: This app helps decipher prescriptions, structure schedules, and alert to hazardous interactions. Always consult a certified doctor before changing, starting, or stopping any medication.
about.p1Body: Doctor handwriting can be illegible or torn. Our system assigns each medicine a confidence score (0.0 to 1.0). If confidence drops below 0.7 (70%), WE NEVER SILENTLY GUESS. We flag that item in bright red and require human confirmation with the pill packaging.
about.p2Body: After AI transcribes a prescription, nothing is silently committed to the schedule. The patient or caregiver is shown an editable table to verify, edit, and confirm.
about.p3Body: To ensure functionality in rural or poor internet connectivity zones, our 30+ most dangerous drug pairs (Warfarin+Aspirin, Metformin+Alcohol, etc.) are embedded directly in code to run offline.
about.p4Body: We do not store raw prescription images permanently on cloud servers. Images are parsed in-memory and discarded. Patients are identified by a local device ID without a password wall.
about.rulesSub: Our risk engine follows certified clinical protocols, not probabilistic LLM guessing:
about.ruleTrends: 🟠 Trend Rule: 3 consecutive increases or a >30% jump above 7-day average triggers automatic family alert!
